company.name: LandRocker
company.shortDescription: LandRocker is a Web3 play-to-earn (P2E) blockchain gaming platform.
company.description: LandRocker is a Web3 play-to-earn (P2E) blockchain gaming platform that combines space exploration, combat missions, and resource mining within a decentralized game economy. The platform allows players to explore virtual planets, complete missions, and earn digital assets such as cryptocurrency tokens, NFTs, and in-game resources that can be traded in a marketplace.

productsAndServices.description: A Telegram-based application that allows users to command rovers and mine planets for crypto rewards directly within the Telegram platform.
productsAndServices.name: LandRocker Telegram Miner App

productsAndServices.description: A mission hub where players complete commands to mine planets, earn LRT tokens, and exchange gathered materials for cryptocurrencies.
productsAndServices.name: LandRocker Command Center

productsAndServices.description: A marketplace for trading, purchasing, and managing NFTs related to the LandRocker game, including assets on Polygon and Immutable zkEVM blockchains.
productsAndServices.name: LandRocker NFT Marketplace

productsAndServices.description: An NFT collection launched on the Immutable blockchain featuring exclusive in-game assets like suits and planets that provide gameplay advantages and passive income opportunities.
productsAndServices.name: Immutable Galaxy NFT Collection

productsAndServices.description: Two gameplay modes: Lite, a browser-based mining game with simple controls; and Pro, a 3D dynamic game requiring rovers and fuel for advanced play-to-earn experiences.
productsAndServices.name: LandRocker Play Modes: Lite and Pro

productsAndServices.description: A program enabling influencers to invite followers via unique treasure maps, earning rewards convertible to LRT tokens based on user engagement and mining activity.
productsAndServices.name: LandRocker Ambassador Program
